create_Act_with_relu: create an Act module with relu activation for a PyTorch neural network layer
create_Act_with_leaky_relu: create an Act module with leaky_relu activation and a custom slope parameter
create_Act_with_softplus: create an Act module with sp or ssp shifted softplus activation
create_Act_with_leaky_variants: create an Act module with leaky_sp, leaky_elu, leaky_ssp, or leaky_tanh activation
test_Act_forward: test the Act forward pass with a torch tensor and verify output shape
